faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at IIEST Shibpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 16th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc degree (awarded) in Chemistry, Physics, or Molecular Biology from a recognized Indian University or Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the salary for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 23,600 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the Walk-in Interview be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at IIEST Shibpur, Howrah, West Bengal, 711103.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Assistant is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from any recognized Indian University/Institute are eligible to apply, provided they meet the other eligibility criteria.
